spans.s:
gama‿āgama, m. going and coming, 🞄going to and fro;
 sg. & pl. negotiation.
gam-in, a. about to go (to ac., —˚).

gambh-īrá = gabhīra: ā, f. N. of a 🞄river;
 (á) -śaṃsa, a. ruling in the depths.

gambhīra‿artha, a. of deep significance;
 🞄-āśaya, a. having a deep thought: 🞄-tāṃ kṛ, conceive a deep thought.
